description.value:
Upgraded by Nomad sharpshooters. Increased reload speed and lethal accuracy — a rifle you can count on.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Anti-Mat. Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 5 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Bipod, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Power Rebuild, Silencer, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon can load Non-Basic Ammunition. All Attack Check penalties are halved (Round Up) when firing this weapon. After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by sacrificing the user’s Move Action as long as they are holding it in two hands. Requires BODY 10+, or BODY 8+ and being Prone, to wield unless Mounted.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Anti-Mat. Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Power Rebuild, Silencer, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
